creator: nicholewischoff
title: VC walks through Instinct, a free iMessage/WhatsApp personal-assistant agent (raised $1B Series C at $10B), with use cases: Gmail/calendar, flights, shopping via Checkmate, reservations, reminders, shared family 'network'

tools.name: Instinct
tools.detail: Text/voice personal assistant inside iMessage or WhatsApp; integrates Gmail, calendar, note apps; free, possibly invite-only; founder 'Noah'

tools.name: Checkmate / Open Stock
tools.detail: Her portfolio company; discounts/cashback engine shown generating a Brooklinen 20% off + 7.5% cashback offer inside Instinct

tools.name: Granola
tools.detail: Note-taking app mentioned as an integration

tools.name: Muse
tools.detail: Another assistant she is onboarding to

tools.name: Rockbot
tools.detail: Another assistant she tried (name as transcribed)

tools.name: United MileagePlus
tools.detail: Instinct pulls her mileage numbers to book flights

claims: Instinct raised a $1B Series C at a $10B valuation; company less than a year old
Completely free, and she thinks they plan to keep it that way; may still be invite-only
'Network' feature: invite family/friends so you can text 'put this on Xander's calendar' and it adds to his calendar after he confirms
Many users share their credit card with it so it can check out and buy things; it cannot log into bank accounts yet
Can call restaurants and doctors' offices on your behalf; proactive reminders ('remind me every 30 minutes until I confirm')

Screen: 'I want to buy new linen, what deals can you generate for me?' -> Brooklinen 20% off sitewide + 7.5% cashback via Checkmate, code INSTINCT-BF20, Luxe Sateen Core Sheet Set $167.20, ordered, arriving Thursday
Speculative use cases she pitches: proactive food reordering, recurring nails/spa/gym bookings, gifting wishlists, travel confirmation checks
how_to_steps: Connect Gmail, calendar and note-taking apps
Text it in iMessage/WhatsApp to confirm bookings, add calendar items for family members, set recurring reminders, buy items
Invite close family/friends to your Instinct 'network' to coordinate logistics
on_screen_only: iMessage screenshot with Instinct: 'I want to buy new linen, what deals can you generate for me?' / 'Done, I generated you a Brooklinen offer through Checkmate: 20% off sitewide plus 7.5% cashback.' / card 'brooklinen 20% off sitewide +7.5% cashback, INSTINCT-BF20, Luxe Sateen Core Sheet Set $167.20, Verified by Checkmate' / 'Want me to order it in queen, white? $167.20, at your door by Thursday.' / 'Yes, go for it' / 'Ordered, arriving Thursday. Your cashback lands in the Checkmate wallet after delivery.'
cta: Download Instinct (free); no explicit follow ask. Discloses 'not an investor' in Instinct but Checkmate is her portfolio company

relevance.why: Consumer assistant, not a build tool. Useful as a signal of where agent UX is going (SMS-first, proactive, shared-network) and as a possible channel/partner for consumer apps, but it does not change our Claude Code workflow.

implement_score.why: Could trial it for personal admin (flights, reminders) to save founder time -- 10 minutes if we can get access. Nothing to build. The 'meet users in iMessage/WhatsApp' pattern is worth noting for any consumer app we ship.

verify: Confirm Instinct's funding ($1B Series C, $10B) from a primary source; the claim comes from a VC enthusiast
Is it actually free / invite-only right now, and what data permissions does it take (Gmail full access, stored card)?
Her conflict of interest: Checkmate is her portfolio company and is featured in the demo
